priorCollectionProvenanceDefect.defect: Collector pinned local CRLF bytes for all three dependency locks; canonical published LF checkout was rejected
priorCollectionProvenanceDefect.newBehavior: Explicit canonical CRLF-to-LF content admission with separate strict raw before/after attestation

limits: This comparison reuses the original product processes; it does not provide two new independent processes per implementation
Actual source module maps are recorded after the first forward; no actual native map was collected in the stock product processes
Source and product configurations use stock channel widths and small 16x16 spatial latents; odd sizes, larger batches and full image generation are not covered
Parameter hashes attest generated bank bytes; complete weight payloads are not retained in artifacts
Accepted reduced-width and prior CLIP profiles remain unchanged; their failing CI results remain open
No pretrained weights, CLIP-H integration, VAE, complete sampling trajectory, GPU, installation or model-family qualification
Budget admission and short memory observations are not a peak-memory bound or proof of freedom from leaks
Full stock executions here used the recorded CRLF lock; LF and CRLF validation was separately checked without native model allocation
